confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from cost-of-living snippets (beer roughly THB 70-120, cappuccino roughly THB 77-80, basic meal roughly THB 100) that vary by venue and source, so they are rough typical values; the cocktail and wine figures are not directly sourced. Cocktail is set at about twice the beer anchor and wine glass at about 1.8 times the beer anchor, because I found no direct cocktail price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Koh Samui resort context, not from live listings or accommodation searches. The FX observation (18 Nov 2026) comes from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates overview page and RSS feed; I did not open the RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable city was used. Priced against Thailand's tourist island and beach-resort towns, with Koh Samui's reported premium of about 18% over the national average taken into account.
